quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #17
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: A traffic light showing a green arrow and a red light means:

options.text: You may only drive straight ahead.
You may drive only in the direction of the green arrow.
You must wait for a solid green light to proceed in any direction.
Vehicles moving in any direction must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may drive only in the direction of the green arrow.
questions.explanation: A green arrow with a red light means you can only drive in the direction of the arrow. The intersection must be clear.

questions.question: ____ greatly increase stopping distance and crash severity.
questions.correctAnswerText: High speeds
questions.explanation: High speeds increase stopping distance and crash severity. The faster you drive, the greater the impact if you crash.

questions.question: An arrow painted on the pavement means:

options.text: Drivers in the correct lane may make the movement shown by the arrow if they choose to.
Drivers in the correct lane must make the movement shown by the arrow only if traffic lights are not working.
Drivers in the correct lane must always stop before making the movement shown by the arrow.
Drivers in the correct lane must make the movement shown by the arrow while following traffic signals.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers in the correct lane must make the movement shown by the arrow while following traffic signals.
questions.explanation: A pavement arrow tells drivers in that lane to make the movement shown by the arrow. Always follow traffic signals before proceeding in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: When entering a street from a driveway, you:

options.text: Must drive slowly to let approaching vehicles and pedestrians move out of your way.
Must honk your horn so approaching vehicles and pedestrians know to give you room.
Must stop and proceed only when no pedestrians or vehicles are approaching.
Can disregard pedestrians if there is no sidewalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must stop and proceed only when no pedestrians or vehicles are approaching.
questions.explanation: Always stop before entering the roadway from a driveway. Yield to any approaching vehicles or pedestrians. Stop before crossing the sidewalk area. Failure to stop is against the law.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that a lane is ending and traffic should merge safely.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Yield the right-of-way at the intersection. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: Crossbuck signs indicate:
questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad crossings.
questions.explanation: Crossbuck signs mark railroad crossings. Yield to trains. Do not try to drive across before a train passes.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road curves right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: You may drive across a dashed white line:

options.text: When it is safe to change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it is safe to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Dashed white lines separate traffic lanes moving in the same direction. You may cross dashed lines to pass when it is safe.

questions.question: If an approaching train is near or going fast enough to be a danger, you must:

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Not cross the tracks until the train has completely passed.
Cross the tracks at your own risk.
Find an alternative route across tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not cross the tracks until the train has completely passed.
questions.explanation: Look and listen for trains before crossing railroad tracks. If a train is near or moving fast enough to be dangerous, do not cross. This applies even if there are no signals or signals are not working.

questions.question: You may pass another vehicle if the line between your lane and the lane you want to enter is a ____ line.
questions.correctAnswerText: Broken white
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes going in the same direction. You can cross broken white lines to pass if the passing lane is clear.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should NOT:

options.text: Check your side and rearview mirrors.
Give a turn signal to show your intention.
Check for other drivers moving into the same lane.
Use your cell phone to call the police to check if the road ahead is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your cell phone to call the police to check if the road ahead is clear.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your side and rearview mirrors for traffic behind you. Use your turn signal to tell other drivers you are changing lanes. Look for other drivers who may be moving into the same lane.

questions.question: You may carefully go through an intersection with a yellow light if:

options.text: There is an emergency vehicle crossing your lane.
You are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.
questions.explanation: If the light turns yellow while you are already in the intersection, you should continue through carefully.

questions.question: Drive slower than the posted speed limit when:

options.text: You are entering a highway with other cars.
You are on a four-lane road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Anything makes driving conditions bad.
questions.explanation: When the road is wet or slippery, or when you cannot see well, drive slower than the posted speed limit. Even if you drive at the speed limit, you can be ticketed for driving too fast for the conditions.

questions.question: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights, you must:

options.text: Slow down and stay in your lane.
Pull to the right curb and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right curb and stop.
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights or hear its siren, pull over to the curb or side of the road and stop right away.

questions.question: If you leave your vehicle unattended, you must:

options.text: Lock the ignition and remove the key.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: When you leave your vehicle unattended, turn off the engine, lock the ignition, remove the key, and set the parking brake.

questions.question: A steady yellow light at an intersection means:

options.text: Slow down and get ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and get ready to stop.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means a red light is coming. If you see yellow ahead, slow down and prepare to stop. If you are already in the intersection or cannot stop safely, continue through carefully.

questions.question: While backing up, you should:

options.text: Open your door to see if it is safe.
Turn your head and look through the rear window.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look through the rear window.
questions.explanation: Always check behind your vehicle before backing up. Children and small objects are hard to see from the driver's seat. Turn your head and look through the rear window while backing. Do not rely only on mirrors or sensors.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended downward. This hand signal means the driver plans to:
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm and hand downward, they are signaling they plan to stop. Adjust your driving if you are following a driver using this signal.

questions.question: How alcohol affects your reflexes and judgment:

options.text: Is less serious with beer instead of wine.
Is less serious with wine instead of beer.
Is worse with hard ciders and mixed drinks.
Depends on the amount of alcohol in your blood.

questions.correctAnswerText: Depends on the amount of alcohol in your blood.
questions.explanation: Any type of alcohol can affect your reflexes and judgment. The type of alcohol does not matter. Only the amount of alcohol in your blood matters.

questions.question: When an emergency vehicle approaches with its siren and/or flashing lights, you must immediately:

options.text: Pull to the right and stop.
Pull to the right and slow down.
Pull to the right and turn on your four-way flashers.
Stop and let the emergency vehicle pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle approaches with lights, sirens, or other warning devices, drive to the right side of the road and stop.

questions.question: ____ limit your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory.

options.text: Only a blood alcohol level greater than the legal limit can
Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
Only a blood alcohol level greater than 0.05 percent can

questions.correctAnswerText: Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol reduces your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory. Your driving skills will suffer. No one can drink and drive safely.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: No right turns.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means no action is allowed. Right turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: If you stop at a railroad crossing with more than one track:

options.text: Wait to proceed until you can see all tracks clearly.
Stop on the first track and watch for another train.
Go through as soon as the train passes.
Go through when one track is free.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait to proceed until you can see all tracks clearly.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with more than one track, do not move as soon as a train passes. Wait until you can see all tracks clearly before crossing. Another train may be approaching.

questions.question: The best way to handle a tailgater is to:

options.text: Speed up to increase distance between you and the tailgater.
Slam on your brakes to make them back off.
Change lanes or slow down gradually to let them pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes or slow down gradually to let them pass.
questions.explanation: Watch your mirrors several times a minute for tailgating or fast-approaching drivers. If a car follows too closely, slow down and let it pass. Most rear-end collisions happen because vehicles follow too closely.

questions.question: You may drive around the gates at a railroad crossing:

options.text: When the lights have stopped flashing.
When other drivers drive around the gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Under no circumstances.
questions.explanation: You must stop at all railroad crossings when warning signals are present. These signals include flashing red lights, lowered gates, flaggers, or train whistles. Never go around a lowered gate.

questions.question: A flashing red light on a traffic signal means:

options.text: The same thing as a stop sign.
You do not have to stop completely.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same thing as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop, yield to traffic and pedestrians, and proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: Increase your following distance when:

options.text: Driving behind a large vehicle that blocks your vision.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Increase your following distance when behind a large vehicle that blocks your view, in bad weather or heavy traffic, when exiting an expressway, when behind a motorcycle or bicycle, and when being tailgated.

questions.question: Your vehicle hits a parked car with no one around. You:

options.text: Have done as much as you can.
Must leave a written note with your name, address, and what happened.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must leave a written note with your name, address, and what happened.
questions.explanation: Stop and try to find the owner. If you cannot find them, leave a written note with your name, address, and details of the accident.

questions.question: Drivers who eat and drink while driving:

options.text: Are better drivers because they are not hungry.

questions.correctAnswerText: Have trouble controlling their vehicles.
questions.explanation: Eating, drinking, or smoking while driving is dangerous. These actions take your hands off the wheel and your eyes off the road. Drivers doing these things have trouble staying in their lanes and controlling their vehicles.

questions.question: Driving is:

options.text: A skill that takes time to learn.

questions.correctAnswerText: A skill that takes time to learn.
questions.explanation: Driving may seem easy at times, but it is a skill that takes time to learn. Do not take it for granted. Driving is a privilege, not a right.

questions.question: A slow-moving vehicle sign is:
questions.correctAnswerText: A triangular orange sign.
questions.explanation: The slow-moving vehicle sign is a reflective orange triangle. Vehicles with this sign are driving at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: If you have the right-of-way at an intersection, you should:

options.text: Assume other drivers will follow right-of-way rules.
Wave other drivers forward before going.
Move through the intersection right away.
Check for other cars, pedestrians, and bicycles before moving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for other cars, pedestrians, and bicycles before moving.
questions.explanation: Do not assume other drivers will follow right-of-way rules. Some drivers may not see or follow traffic signals. Always use good judgment when crossing an intersection.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads, you should:

options.text: Drive the same as you would on dry roads.
Stay farther away from the car ahead of you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther away from the car ahead of you.
questions.explanation: On slippery roads, increase your distance from the car ahead. It takes longer to stop your vehicle on slippery surfaces.

questions.question: Drivers should watch closely for motorcyclists, bicyclists, and pedestrians because:

options.text: They are hard to see in traffic.
They follow different traffic laws than cars.
They do not have rearview mirrors.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are hard to see in traffic.
questions.explanation: In many accidents involving motorcycles, bicycles, and pedestrians, drivers said they were looking but did not see them. These road users are smaller and harder to spot than cars. To prevent crashes, always look for motorcycles, bikes, and pedestrians.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When driving slowly disrupts traffic flow.
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone.
Only when driving in rural areas.

questions.correctAnswerText: When driving slowly disrupts traffic flow.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive so slowly that you disrupt traffic. You can receive a ticket for driving too slowly.

questions.question: Look over your shoulder to check your blind spot when:

options.text: Pulling toward or away from a curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Check your blind spot every time you change your vehicle's position. This includes turning, changing lanes, and pulling toward or away from a curb.

questions.question: A red traffic light means you must:
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: A red light means you must stop before entering the intersection. You must stop at the stop line and before entering any crosswalk.

questions.question: When making a turn, you must ____ your speed.
questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed when turning. This helps you stay in control, remain in your lane, and react to surprises.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.
